facts.fact: Finance minister Doudou Fwamba said on RTNC that VAT tele-declaration (e-filing) has been generalised at the Direction generale des impots.
Minister Fwamba said the E-Finance programme, structured with Huawei and mobilising over US$150m, funds management applications including the DGI's ERP, plus agency interconnection and data centres.
Finance minister Doudou Fwamba, on RTNC, listed the generalisation of VAT tele-declaration among the public-finance reforms carried out.

facts.fact: Kinshasa's provincial revenue directorate (DGRK) launched irms-dgrk.com on 5 March 2026 for online filing of provincial tax returns, and the business federation FEC says teledeclaration is possible but little known.
The DGRK says irms-dgrk.com lets taxpayers settle tax obligations through several modern payment means.
